SUCH HINDRANCE IN THE WORK ENDORSED BY THE PURCHASER WI LL ONLY BE TAKEN INTO CONSIDERATION FOR GRANTING DELIVERY DATE RE-FIXATION. 4) PERFORMANCE SECURITY DEPOSIT IN THE FORM OF DD/BG IN ORIGINAL SHALL BE SUBM ITTED TO THE FOLLOWING ADDRESS WITHIN 15 DAYS FROM THE DATE OF AWARD OF CON TRACT:

ASSISTANT PURCHASE OFFICER Regional Purchase Unit, DPS, Heavy Water General Facilities, DAE colony, ECIL Road, ECIL Post, Hyderabad TELANGANA- 500062. As per Flowchart bidder has to select Regional Purchase Unit (M) Hyd-EMD/SD account for making payment in Bharatkosh.
